security_audit.summary: The static external command and path traversal alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline code, and relative documentation links. The skill has a real business-logic risk because it sends Gmail messages and can attach local files, but it includes a caution to confirm before execution.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before any non-dry-run send. Prefer dry-run or draft mode until recipients, subject, body, and attachments are approved.
Before using attachments, show each file path and ask the user to approve every file that will leave the local system.
Bundle the shared security guidance or keep the sibling path fixed so installers do not need broad filesystem traversal.

semantic_findings.title: Outbound Email and Attachment Side Effects
semantic_findings.description: The skill instructs the agent to send Gmail messages and supports local file attachments. This can expose data or send unauthorized communications if executed without explicit user approval.

content.value_statement: Writing Gmail commands by hand can slow routine communication. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to send or draft Gmail messages with the gws CLI.
actual_capabilities: Sends Gmail messages with recipient, subject, and body fields.
Adds CC, BCC, and send-as alias options when requested.
Supports plain text or HTML message bodies.
Attaches one or more local files to a message.
Can preview a request with dry-run mode.
Can save a message as a draft instead of sending it.
limitations: Requires the gws CLI and Google Workspace authentication.
Cannot send safely without explicit user approval.
Does not verify recipient intent outside the provided prompt.

use_cases.title: Send Team Updates
use_cases.description: Prepare and send short Gmail updates to a team after the user confirms the recipients and content.

use_cases.title: Draft Client Messages
use_cases.description: Create Gmail drafts for client communication so a user can review details before sending.

use_cases.title: Share Reports
use_cases.description: Send approved report files as Gmail attachments with a clear subject and body.

prompt_templates.title: Send a Basic Email
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Gmail to send Alice a short update with the subject Project status. Ask me to confirm before sending.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Gmail draft for the customer update. Use the recipients and body below, and do not send it yet.

prompt_templates.title: Send with Recipients
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a Gmail message with To, CC, and BCC recipients. Show me the final recipient list before any send action.

prompt_templates.title: Send Attachments Safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a Gmail message with the approved attachments. Use dry-run first, then ask for confirmation before sending.

output_examples.input: Send a status email to Alice and copy Bob.
output_examples.output: The assistant confirms Alice as recipient, Bob as copy recipient, and previews the subject and body before sending.

output_examples.input: Draft a client follow-up with a report attached.
output_examples.output: The assistant creates a Gmail draft and lists the attachment for review, without sending the message.

output_examples.input: Send an HTML announcement after I approve it.
output_examples.output: The assistant prepares the HTML message, shows a preview, and waits for approval before using Gmail.

best_practices: Use dry-run before sending messages with many recipients or attachments.
Confirm recipients, subject, body, and attachments in one clear review step.
Use draft mode when the message needs human review.
anti_patterns: Do not send messages based only on implied approval.
Do not attach local files unless the user named and approved them.
Do not place sensitive content in HTML without user review.

faq.question: Does this skill send email directly?
faq.answer: Yes. It can send Gmail messages through the gws CLI after user confirmation.

faq.question: Can it create drafts instead of sending?
faq.answer: Yes. Use draft mode when a message needs review before delivery.

faq.question: Can it include attachments?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports one or more attachments, subject to Gmail limits and user approval.

faq.question: Does it support HTML email?
faq.answer: Yes. It can treat the message body as HTML when requested.

faq.question: What authentication is required?
faq.answer: The user needs the gws CLI configured with valid Google Workspace access.

faq.question: Is it safe for automated sending?
faq.answer: Use caution. Confirm every non-draft send, especially when recipients or attachments are involved.
